review_candidates.title: Senior Test Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Requirements : Advanced Python scripting - building and maintaining test automation frameworks (not just writing scripts): reusable test libraries, fixtures, and CI-integrated suites. Test case design and defect tracking (Jira) - clear, reproducible bug reports and maintained regression suites. Ability to translate technical specifications and requirements into test plans that catch edge cases before release. Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken, it's a must 6 to 8 years
eligibility_evidence: EgyBell is hiring a Senior Test Engineer for a multinational telecommunications company.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements : Advanced Python scripting - building and maintaining test automation frameworks (not just writing scripts): reusable test libraries, fixtures, and CI-integrated suites. Ability to translate technical specifications and requirements into test plans that catch edge cases before release. Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken, it's a must 6 to 8 years of experience as a Test Engineer or in a similar position Preferred qualifications: Exposure to telecom/network protocol domain work and experience with mobile core network signaling protocols across 2G/3G/4G (SS7/MAP, Diameter, GTP-C/GTP-U).
